---
title: "02d — CH2025 ingestion check (precip rasters)"
---

Diagnostic for the CH2025 climate ingestion (`02-ingest-preds-ch2025-*`). Rebuilds the
seasonal precipitation predictors (`pr_DJF/JJA/MAM/SON`) from `pred_data_t` back onto
the coordinate grid and plots them, as a visual sanity check that the extract/load
produced sensible spatial fields. Read-only.

> Note: `id_pred in (11, 12, 13, 14)` assumes those ids are the four seasonal `pr`
> predictors under `id_run = 0`, `id_period = 0`; confirm against `db$pred_meta_t`
> (printed below) if the ids have shifted.

```{r}
#| label: ch2025-precip-check
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 7
library(evoland)
library(terra)
library(data.table)
db <- evoland_db$new(path = "ssp-ch.evolanddb")
coords_minimal <- db$coords_minimal

# check for pr_DJF, pr_JJA, pr_MAM, pr_SON
db$pred_meta_t
dat <- db$fetch(
  table_name = "pred_data_t",
  cols = c("id_pred", "id_coord", "value"), # assuming that id_run = 0 and id_period = 0
  where = "id_pred in (11, 12, 13, 14)"
)

precip_rast <- tabular_to_raster(
  dat,
  coords_minimal,
  value_col = "value"
)

# render inline (Quarto captures the figure; no writeRaster to disk)
terra::plot(precip_rast)
```
